description:
As a customer, I want to sort the products.

* Sorting should work properly.

cases.title: Products are reordered when a sort option is applied
cases.preconditions: The application is available and a product list containing several products is displayed. The tester knows which sort options the application offers (the story does not specify the sort options).
steps: Note the current order of the displayed products.
Select one of the available sort options.
Observe the product list after the sort option is applied.
cases.expected: The product list is sorted according to the selected sort option; the displayed order of all products matches that sort option. The exact sort options, ordering rules and any message or indicator are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Each available sort option sorts the product list correctly
cases.preconditions: The application is available and a product list containing several products is displayed.
steps: Select the first available sort option and check the resulting order of the products.
Repeat for every remaining sort option offered by the application, checking the resulting order each time.
cases.expected: For every sort option, the product list is ordered according to that option. No sort option leaves the list unsorted or in the order of a different option. The exact set of sort options is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting a list with no products
cases.preconditions: The application is available and a product list that contains no products is displayed (for example an empty category or a search with no results).
steps: Select one of the available sort options.
cases.expected: Sorting is handled without an error or crash; the list remains empty. Any specific message or behaviour for an empty list is not specified in the story.
